## LANDED — `d7f0601ee72ba646c296dcd8c1f65343f6877ac3`. Probe on `<merge>^ <merge>`: **7 of 7 legs pass.**

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), R55. PR objectui#9315 merged 2026-09-12T20:0xZ.

### ⚠️ errata 62b — it FIRED here, and the re-count is what makes the probe mean anything

The legs were counted on `f080538813`. This entry queued **stacked on PR objectui#9314**, so the merge parent is its queue head:

```
merge  = d7f0601ee72ba646c296dcd8c1f65343f6877ac3
parent = 2ae014f969cdc455f476980671cf35f27fb9ab99   ← objectui#9314's merge, NOT the counted base
```

Re-derived before reading the probe as passed: objectui#9314 touches `.changeset/README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and a changeset — ⛔ **not** this PR's subject file — and re-counting **directly on the stacked base** reproduced all seven expected values. ⭐ **Fourth time today a base moved under a probe.** ⇒ a stacked entry is the **common case** when this seat lands several PRs in a session, ⛔ not an anomaly, and 「the queue base equals `main`」 is a reading with a shelf life.

| leg | expected | parent | merge | |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `'./*'` | 0 → 2 | 0 | 2 | ✅ |
| `isClassEntry` | 0 → 2 | 0 | 2 | ✅ |
| `endsWith('/*')` | 0 → 2 | 0 | 2 | ✅ |
| ⭐ `endsWith('/**')` | 2 → 2 | 2 | 2 | ✅ |
| ⭐⭐ `'**/*.md'` | 0 → 0 | 0 | 0 | ✅ |
| ⭐⭐ `'**'` | 0 → 0 | 0 | 0 | ✅ |
| ⭐ `'scripts'` in `SCAN_ROOTS` | 1 → 1 | 1 | 1 | ✅ |

⭐ **The two must-STAY-ABSENT legs are the point of this probe.** The failure mode this card invites is closing the root gap by reaching for a repo-wide glob — 「a glob that runs the full suite on every doc typo is **the cure being worse**」 was the original fence's own phrasing. Those legs go red the moment anyone writes one. And `endsWith('/**')` holding at 2 pins that the depth-1 class was added **beside** the any-depth class rather than replacing it.

### What shipped

The repository root now has a **tree spelling**, and it is bounded. Two spellings separated by DEPTH: `dir/**` is every markdown under `dir` at any depth; `dir/*` is every markdown directly IN `dir` and none deeper. The root is `./*` — an empty prefix plus a 「no remaining separator」 test.

⭐ I re-measured that bound myself rather than taking it from the report, with a lit control in the same run:

| path | `./*` | `docs/**` (control) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SECURITY.md` · `NOTES.md` · `AGENTS.md` · `README.md` | **MATCH** | no |
| `docs/NOTES.md` | **no** | MATCH |
| `docs/a/b/c.md` | — | MATCH |
| `packages/x/README.md` · `content/docs/a/b.md` | **no** | — |

⇒ root, depth 1, nothing deeper. The control proves the matcher is live rather than uniformly refusing, so the 「no」 column is a reading. **The resolved-input-list fence objectui#9096 set survives**: a class with a bound, ⛔ not a glob.

### ⭐ Two consequences the round found and handled, neither asked for

1. **`missingDocuments()` now skips class entries** — the trap triage named. A class entry names no file, so looking for it on disk would have reported the new root spelling as a missing document.
2. ⭐ **`markdownTestInputsAmong()` now reports EVERY covering entry, not the first sorted.** Entries have always overlapped; first-match-wins attributed a root document to whichever rule sorted first and **silently dropped the rest**. Measured over all 1814 tracked documents: **130 documents GAINED readers, none lost**, declared population `1814 → 1814`, `lost verdict: []`.

### ⭐ The acceptance numbers had drifted AGAIN, and were re-derived rather than carried

The card said 1734 of 1734; objectui#9141's round re-measured **1805**; today's tip reads **1814**. ⛔ Neither inherited figure was used. ⇒ third card in a row where the number moved under it. **A stale acceptance number is a prediction, not a fact.**

### ⭐ The instrument caught the person extending it

The ledger's self-audit went red on the dev's **own new test file** — a string literal `packages/app-shell/README.md` in it registered as an unadjudicated candidate. Adjudicated honestly into that test's `notRead`; ⛔ no exemption widened to get green. The gap was also reproduced **before** the fix by extracting and running the real `ci.yml` step against a real git repo with nine planted pull requests, and the complete before/after diff is exactly four lines — the two planted root documents flipping `should_run=false → true`, the other seven cases byte-identical, with `SECURITY.md` pinned absent from the tree so the control could not degrade into an already-declared document.

⚠️ **objectui#9241 is now the only card left in this `ci.yml`-trigger family**, and it may ⛔ not inherit the post-merge probe hash `37c2d95659c9fffa` — that must be re-taken against the current tip.

Closing objectui#9142, stripping `pm:*` and the assignee.
